title: CTA Register Link
description: CTA-500 orange uppercase link in heading font. Used for the Register action in the header. Hover darkens to CTA-700.

styles.css: &{transition: color 200ms ease;} & a{transition: color 200ms ease;} & a:hover{color: var(--wp--preset--color--cta-700); text-decoration: none;} & a:active{color: var(--wp--preset--color--cta-700); text-decoration: none;} & a:focus-visible{color: var(--wp--preset--color--cta-700); outline: 2px solid var(--wp--preset--color--focus-background); outline-offset: 2px;}
